name: There Will Come Soft Rains
source:
You're a mouse. Clean a house.

An attempt to adapt the incredible short story "There Will Come Soft Rains" written by Ray Bradbury. 

The events in each room change based on when you clean them. Multiple endings based on final branch.

[From [url=https://cuttlefishofdoom.itch.io/there-will-come-soft-rains]Itch.io[/url]]
